name: Private Beta Watch
description: Operational dashboard for onboarding, preview, billing, and provider-discovery issues while the first external beta users are active.

charts.text:
## Private beta watch
Use this dashboard while onboarding new users and during live beta sessions.

Top row = core health counters for the last 24h.
Middle rows = webhook, queue, failure, billing, and provider-discovery signals over time.
Bottom row = recent failures and recent beta-watch events for triage.

query.apl: ['yaffle'] | where ['name'] == "POST /api/webhooks/github" or ['body'] == "webhook received" | summarize total=count() | project ['total']
['yaffle'] | where ['body'] contains "blocked by" and isnotempty(['attributes.blocked']) | summarize total_blocked=sum(['attributes.blocked']) | project ['total_blocked']
['yaffle'] | where ['body'] == "job.cancelled" or ['body'] contains "cleanup" or ['body'] contains "destroy" or ['name'] contains "/destroy" | summarize total=count() | project ['total']

['yaffle'] | where ['body'] contains "stripe webhook" or ['body'] contains "payment failed" or ['body'] contains "signature verification failed" or ['name'] == "POST /api/webhooks/stripe" | summarize total=count() | project ['total']
['yaffle'] | where ['body'] startswith "provider_discovery." or ['name'] == "POST /api/internal/provider-discovery/results" | summarize total=count() | project ['total']
['yaffle'] | where ['body'] in ("job.failed", "job.stale_timeout") | summarize count() by bin(['_time'], 15m), ['body']

['yaffle'] | where ['body'] contains "blocked by" | extend reason = case(['body'] contains "global", "global", ['body'] contains "per-group", "per-group", "other") | summarize count() by bin(['_time'], 15m), ['reason']

['yaffle'] | where ['name'] == "POST /api/webhooks/github" or ['body'] == "webhook received" | extend event = case(isnotempty(['attributes.webhook.event']), ['attributes.webhook.event'], "unknown") | summarize count() by bin(['_time'], 15m), ['event']

['yaffle'] | where ['body'] contains "stripe webhook" or ['body'] contains "payment failed" or ['body'] contains "signature verification failed" or ['name'] == "POST /api/webhooks/stripe" | extend signal = case(['body'] contains "payment failed", "payment_failed", ['body'] contains "signature verification failed", "bad_signature", ['body'] contains "stripe webhook", "webhook_log", ['name'] == "POST /api/webhooks/stripe", "webhook_request", "other") | summarize count() by bin(['_time'], 15m), ['signal']

['yaffle'] | where ['body'] startswith "provider_discovery." or ['name'] == "POST /api/internal/provider-discovery/results" | extend signal = case(['body'] contains "queue_failed", "queue_failed", ['body'] contains "callback_apply_failed", "callback_apply_failed", ['body'] contains "incomplete_result", "incomplete_result", ['body'] contains "queued", "queued", ['body'] contains "dispatched", "dispatched", ['body'] contains "applied", "applied", ['name'] == "POST /api/internal/provider-discovery/results", "callback_request", "other") | summarize count() by bin(['_time'], 15m), ['signal']

['yaffle'] | where ['body'] in ("job.failed", "job.stale_timeout") | order by ['_time'] desc | project ['_time'], ['attributes.job.id'], ['attributes.job.type'], ['attributes.orgSlug'], ['attributes.repo'], ['attributes.error.message'], ['body'] | take 50

['yaffle'] | where ['body'] in ("job.failed", "job.stale_timeout", "job.cancelled") or ['body'] contains "stripe webhook" or ['body'] contains "payment failed" or ['body'] contains "provider_discovery." or ['body'] contains "cleanup" or ['body'] contains "destroy" or ['name'] == "POST /api/webhooks/stripe" or ['name'] == "POST /api/internal/provider-discovery/results" | order by ['_time'] desc | project ['_time'], ['body'], ['name'], ['attributes.job.type'], ['attributes.orgSlug'], ['attributes.repo'], ['attributes.prNumber'] | take 50
